scope: Market Researcher v3 six skills and shared reasoning references; sample Vision current-contract audit
metric_limit: Twelve previously studied historical cases, eleven baseline-blind after source-only extraction and B04 excluded for accidental baseline exposure; zero outcome files viewed. No ground-truth label/accuracy/profitability score is asserted. All twelve retain conditional developing WATCHs; B01/B02/B03/B05/B06 have substantive trigger hypotheses, but no complete first-obstacle economic admission is independently established in this sample. This pass alone does not demonstrate positive economic entry acceptance. Minor lower-timeframe obstacles are reported explicitly; their policy significance must be frozen rather than used as an unversioned veto against unchanged controls.
calculation_version: review numeric descriptors: SMA14 true-range ATR, ewm(adjust=False) EMA20/50 over available closed history, strict unique 2L/2R pivots; not substitutions into frozen controls

cases.market_map: 4h descriptive EMA20/50 are downward (0.70610/0.71121) and 1h order is also downward, but the recent 1h sequence rebounded from 0.6845 to 0.6967. The 0.6967 1h resistance was confirmed at 10:00; the 12:30 15m bar traded to 0.7007 and closed back at 0.6962. The later 13:10–13:15 5m close 0.6951 extends that rejection. This is a meaningful resistance reaction in a broader down context, not simply EMA says sell.
cases.long_hypothesis: WATCH a renewed accepted recovery through 0.6967/0.7007 or a new defended pullback for reversal/rotation research. The 4h down context is a contradiction requiring a stronger long trigger, not a ban on watching it.
cases.short_hypothesis: WATCH / TRIGGER_CANDIDATE a sweep/reclaim short of the pre-known 0.6967 level, followed by the later local downside confirmation. A failed rally within the higher-timeframe down context is coherent.
cases.breakout_vs_sweep: The high crossed a known 1h resistance and the completed close returned below it; subsequent closes failed to regain it. This supports failed-breakout rather than accepted continuation. The 0.7007 15m pivot becomes confirmed only at 13:15 and cannot be called a confirmed pivot at 12:30.

nearest_obstacles.basis: recent defended low, confirmed on 5m at 12:50; 15m only at decision cutoff

cases.structural_invalidation: A full-sweep short invalidates above 0.7007 plus a declared buffer. A later lower-high continuation variant would be a separate plan; do not quietly replace full excursion risk with a tiny signal-bar stop.
cases.entry_research_decision: RESEARCHABLE_SHORT_TRIGGER_HYPOTHESIS but NO_TRADE_COMPLETE_PLAN at 0.6951 under first-obstacle economics. A stop above 0.7007 is already over .80% away before buffer, while nearby support 0.6938 is only .19% away. A policy that explicitly targets a higher-timeframe objective must record these intermediate obstacles as caution rather than claim they are absent; this review does not silently alter frozen strategy rules.
cases.strongest_contradiction: A coherent short setup still faces nearby defended support and the recent hourly rebound. Pattern correctness does not establish sufficient target room.
cases.over_rejection_check: Do not discard the short merely because the last few 1h closes rose or the 5m fast EMA sits over the slow EMA; the meaningful resistance failure deserves investigation.
